Whether you're experiencing symptoms or not, please get tested if you believe you've been exposed. 

Between vaccines, boosters, masks and testing, we have the tools to finally put an end to this thing.

The recent fires in New York and Philadelphia are symptoms of our country's housing crisis. 

Our country has the resources to provide affordable, *safe* housing to all. It's time we use them. 

My Public Housing Fire Safety Act would be a key step toward making that happen.

I'm proud to support the #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act, which includes aid for adult suicide prevention services and treatment for those with serious mental illnesses. It's time to treat mental health with the seriousness we treat physical health.

In the wealthiest country in the world, no American should go hungry. Watch today at 10 AM as I join @AppropsDems to mark up a funding bill that tackles hunger and nutrition insecurity with funding for programs like WIC, SNAP, and school meals: https://t.co/Tq4GUUCK1U

Due to structural barriers to mental health care, only one in three Black Americans with mental illness can access the treatment they need.

This #MinorityMentalHealthAwarenessMonth, let's shatter the stigma of mental illness and rethink the way our country treats mental health. https://t.co/Pt2bl6xClT

The Biden Administration will host the White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health TOMORROW, September 28. The Conference will focus on the importance of improving food access and affordability while emphasizing nutrition.

Register here: https://t.co/TlO8WMfDez

Starting in 30 minutes!

https://t.co/TlO8WMxe67

They Include mental health equity, funding for public transit, and an increase in funding for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), which provides lifesaving assistance for Americans facing food insecurity.

Shows like Daniel Tiger remind kids that it's okay to not be okay. I'm glad that the conversation around mental health is evolving.

As we work toward breaking the stigma, we must also ensure that all kids and teens can access the care they need.  
https://t.co/vpeqD6z9nT

Shouldn’t sleep on Jersey, Mr. President.

Congrats @PUTIGERS !!!

We need a comprehensive plan that protects health and wellness, and My Stay Cool Act does just that by mitigating health risks. Extreme heat isn’t going anywhere. We must start making emergency preparedness a priority.
https://t.co/sPe8HGBXOS

Our LGBTQI+ elders are disproportionately impacted by HIV & AIDS.

As a member of the @EqualityCaucus, I am working to end the stigma, ensure access to preventative medicines like PrEP for all of those at risk, & improve access to testing and treatment. https://t.co/9pconVSwI0

World Food Day commemorates the founding of the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization, which has improved nutrition and food security for countless individuals around the globe. Let us always remember that access to nutritious food is a basic human right.

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

Did you know that breast cancer is the most common cancer among women worldwide? Being aware of the signs and symptoms of breast cancer, and getting regular screenings can help save a life. https://t.co/fC0v6T7i9k

Join @RepDonDavis and I for a panel discussion on food and nutrition security in marginalized communities featuring Dr. Tameka Owens of the @USDA and Dr. Jen Cadenhead of the @tischfoodcenter. 
Thursday, November 30th at 4PM https://t.co/eHQOkwgqUT

I am heartbroken to learn about the devastating fire in Plainfield. My heart goes out to the residents and first responders dealing with this tragic incident.
https://t.co/pf0DEVgJw0

The recent fires are symptoms of our country's housing crisis.

Thank you @RepDonDavis!

To see our discussion on nutrition and the impact of federal legislation you can watch the entire panel here: https://t.co/YQJLAtQnhH

On Nat'l Black HIV/AIDS Awareness Day, we acknowledge the disparate impact of HIV/AIDS on the Black community and recommit to expanding access to treatment and prevention.

That's why I've introduced the PrEP Assistance Program Act to ensure everyone can get the care they need. https://t.co/HUXxDtONnw

Today, I sat down with the Director of @theNCI to discuss how we can bring cutting edge treatment to underserved and rural communities that often struggle to access research hospitals.

We also discussed the importance of cancer research and diversifying the healthcare workforce. https://t.co/XyncZrtTNv

Offering more than just a roof over their heads, warm food to eat and soft beds to sleep in, since 1978 Anchor House has equipped young people with the skills and resources necessary for lasting stability in their lives.
It was an honor to help them open their 5th location! https://t.co/KLIzmd191u

Last week, Republicans released their proposal for the Farm Bill. It includes the largest cut to SNAP in 30 years.

The GOP is more willing to cut support for 42 million Americans who rely on nutrition assistance than make the wealthiest 0.01% pay what they owe in taxes.

NJ-12 residents! Join us for a Health & Wellness Resource Clinic and Town Hall TOMORROW at the Montgomery Municipal Center. 

The Resource Clinic is from 4-6pm and the Town Hall is from 6-7pm. Looking forward to seeing you there!

More information below: https://t.co/oa8mMWFner

Today's the day! NJ-12 residents, stop by the Montgomery Municipal Center this afternoon for our health & wellness resource clinic and town hall! The resource clinic runs from 4-6pm, and the town hall from 6-7pm. See you there!

Thank you to everyone who attended our health & wellness resource clinic tonight! 

If you couldn’t make it, but need help with the IRS, USCIS, Medicare, Social Security or the VA, please contact my District Office at 609-883-0026. A member of my team will be happy to assist you! https://t.co/R6HZcP9IuI

A big thank you to everyone who came to our health & wellness town hall in Montgomery last night!

I'm especially grateful to all the young people who showed up and asked thoughtful questions about mental health, healthcare policy, and what we can do to improve access to care. https://t.co/vdHB5LINJ4
